newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH FLY-HALF PENAUD TO MISS WALES MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH FLY-HALF PENAUD TO MISS WALES MATCH.

text.p: French fly-half Alain Penaud will miss the Five Nations' championship match against Wales in Paris on February 15 because of a left ankle injury sustained during the European Cup final against Leicester last month.

The injury is not serious enough for the Brive fly-half, who played in the opening Five Nations encounter against Ireland in Dublin, to need surgery but he has been ordered to rest if he hopes to be fit to face England at Twickenham on March 1.
"I need to rest and I might be back by the end of the month", Penaud told the sports daily L'Equipe.
Earlier in the week, Toulouse centre Thomas Catsaignede was ruled out of both the Wales and England matches after his jaw was broken in a club game against Castres.
